scenes: Before you buy, fund or start something: ask four questions.
Does it really protect people here? | Is it fair? | Who keeps it working? | And who pays, and who carries the risk?
There are twenty-four in all, | with the rules and ways of paying that have helped elsewhere.
Protection that works, lasts and reaches everyone.
